name: web-security-timeline-card-with-monospace-alert-row-and-pink-node
title: Card 'Email Security Enhancements' with a monospace flagged-activity row, a vertical line of grey nodes and a pink active node under a cursor
whatItIs: A white rounded card with a bold title and grey description, a monospace row 'Malicious email activity flagged 04:53' with an open circle, a thin line dropping to a pink node under a mouse cursor and three more grey ringed nodes below.

Highlight the active node in pink.
Add a cursor to imply interaction.
